label: DB準備
info: 起動時にテーブルを作り、部品が0件ならデモデータを入れる。

name: 起動時: テーブル作成 → 部品が0件ならデモデータ投入
テーブル作成SQL
func:
msg.topic = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    kana TEXT NOT NULL,
    department TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parts (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    location TEXT NOT NULL,
    stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reorder_point INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    departments TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    part_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    orderer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordered_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '入荷待ち',
    received_date TEXT,
    received_qty INTEGER,
    receiver_id TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    ts TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    part_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    worker_id TEXT,
    worker_name TEXT,
    department TEXT,
    note TEXT DEFAULT ''
);";
return msg;

name: 検索語
func:
msg.params = { $q: "%" + (msg.req.query.q || "").trim() + "%" };
return msg;

sql:
SELECT p.*, p.stock <= p.reorder_point AS below_point,
  (SELECT json_object('id', o.id, 'part_id', o.part_id, 'quantity', o.quantity,
     'orderer_id', o.orderer_id, 'ordered_date', o.ordered_date,
     'expected_date', o.expected_date, 'status', o.status)
   FROM orders o WHERE o.part_id = p.id AND o.status = '入荷待ち' ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 1) AS waiting_order
FROM parts p
WHERE p.id LIKE $q OR p.name LIKE $q ORDER BY p.id
